The ai usage in posters and pictures bothers me to such a degree I won't be buying copies for friends or playing it until its removed. There are artists who will do the work, it is very saddening to see such a good game decide to skimp out on such a small thing. Sure 'its a small problem' but ai isn't some amazing thing. Its a thief that can't even understand why or what its stealing. I genuinely love this game, and I'd love to see them be able to remove the ai disclosure which I don't think was there when I bought it, if it was, then whatever but this small problem is a large moral problem for me as an artist.

One of the best games you can play! 126 hours and I have yet to complete all of the Trials! So much replay ability with modifiers, MK’s or even just prestige and the content you can receive for FREE. You earn 1000 of the in game currency through the Onboarding Catalog so might as well spend it on another catalog that also gives you your money back. The events give good rewards. You can get cool skins now for your Rigs! It’s gory and kinda insane so If you are skeptical I would definitely recommend purchasing especially if it goes on sale. You will 100% get your moneys worth!!!

Wow, just wow Red Barrels can't miss can they

• Absolutely blown away by how fun and smooth it plays it does not feel like an Early Access game what so ever feels more of a complete game than Jedi: Survivor and that's saying something.

• 4-Hours in and I only have good things to say, the universe they built is one of a kind, grimmy, dark and specially gory I love Red Barrels for going all in and not holding back when it comes to art direction.

• The CO-OP gameplay just works and plays amazingly and to think this is their first ever Multiplayer/Online game is crazy. they've nailed the things that make a CO-OP game unique and fun, even playing with randoms that don't really cooperate still feels like they cooperate if that makes any sense.

• Not introducing any kind of MTX is a big win also, I can only see this game blooming from here on out. Red Barrels is yet to disappoint. the future is very bright and has big potential and I'm all for it!

One of the best online co-op games I've ever played. I don't get why it's so under the radar. I usually despise horror games because I get scared easily, but this one isn't scary at all. I have only 20 hours so far, but I can easily see this becoming my main game in the future. Peak

Verdict: Recommended!

The Outlast Trials is an incredibly fun and intense experience, especially when playing with friends or other players. The atmosphere is terrifying, the objectives keep you engaged - like an escape room vibe, and the feeling of trying to survive while everything goes wrong makes every run memorable. Horror + teamwork + chaos creates some genuinely unforgettable moments. One thing I love about this is you can actually throw something to the Ex-Pops!

I really hope more players give this game a chance. It deserves a bigger and more active player base because the experience is so much better when you have more people to play with.

One of my all time favs, and probably my fav co-op game. Not only are the graphics and the design of the game absolutely incredible, but also huge props to Red Barrels constantly improving the game and being active w the community. The game itself is really fun and amusing, but the character design and the lore take it to a whole different level. So I def recommend everyone to play it!!

i'm still figuring out how this game works, but so far, its been a really good game and really good experience. i do like the mechanics and the details put into this game. its not really what i would go for to play a game by myself, but with friends or other players its a really good game.

Never in a million years would I expect one of the best live-service games on the market would be the Co-op Outlast spin-off.

Has value as a solo horror game but really shines as a group, whether friends or randoms.

You are God's justice, and my b*tch wife is your heretic. It is your solemn vow to strike down the unfaithful and preserve that which is just. Root out the witch's corruption, remind her of the virtues of boy's night, and we will let you out.

This game is one of the best games I've ever had the opportunity to play. It is so well made, the devs seem to care about their players a lot and I have seen nothing but positive reviews on them! I love that you can change up difficulty, play solo or with others, and each trial is something new when you play. The cost of the packs are so affordable, where you'd spend $10 on one skin for another game, you get multiple skins and room decor for as little as $5. I appreciate that so much. I can't wait to see what else they do with this game and I will find myself wanting to play this game tons as time goes on. Thank you for making my new favorite game! (:
The game is a fun time with friends, albeit it does diminish some of the horror aspects of the game. But It is a must get if you play horror games, and especially with friends.

Beautifully grotesque and endlessly entertaining

This game is so packed full of lore and interesting story lines, captivating details in all areas, and wonderfully unique characters that never fail to bring you back in. This game is carefully crafted with so much love from the development team. The voices behind Leland Coyle, Mother Gooseberry and Franco Barbie all do a phenomenal job at completely enveloping their characters and giving their best performances, making each round so immersive and daunting to navigate

Even after you've managed to get to the "end" of the game, the weekly trials make it so easy to keep having fun. Amazing to play solo, and even more amazing with friends. I knew nothing about Outlast before playing this game and I've still managed to absolutely fall in love with it! I could not recommend this game enough
